title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: A sale ad read: “Buy three tires at the regular price and get the fourth tire for \(\$3.\)” Sam paid \(\$240\) for a set of four tires at the sale. What was the regular price of one tire?

solutions.text:
The three regular-price tires cost \(\$240 - \$3 = \$237.\)

So one tire costs \(\dfrac{\$237}{3} = \$79.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The \(\$240\) covers three tires at the regular price plus \(\$3\) for the fourth
Subtract the \(\$3,\) then divide the rest among the three full-price tires
